# Draft:IndieFEST Film Awards

IndieFEST Film Awards is an online film competition that launched in 2008. It is headquartered in La Jolla, CA and its director is Rick Prickett.
Categories
The award categories include:
* Best of Show
* Award of Excellence
* Award Of Merit
* Award of Recognition
* Annual Humanitarian Award
Rules
Multiple entries from one filmmaker is allowed and each filmmaker may apply to multiple categories. There is a $60 USD entry fee for the first category and $40 USD for each additional category.
Select past winners
* 2014 - Love Thy Nature, Best of Show
* 2014 - Snowflake, Best Short Film, Best Leading Actress (Ele Keats),  Best Supporting Actress (Tracy Middendorf)
* 2017 - Bully, Award of Merit, LGBT
* 2021 - Brave Blue World, Best of Show
